integrity: The closed formula is proved analytically by partitioning unordered vertex pairs and counting their shortest paths. A breadth-first-search verifier is used only as a finite stress test and not as evidence for the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only complete bipartite graphs with a matching deleted. It does not solve the full fixed-order bipartite extremal problem. An equivalent formula under terminology not surfaced by the inspected literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Geodesic subpath numbers of bicliques with a deleted matching
